svg.title: Crafitys GLaDOS electrical power and signal map
svg.desc: ESP32-C3 powered by the PC USB-C five volt supply. External twenty-four volt supply powers the A4988 and a DC DC converter set to five volts for the two servos. All grounds are joined. Screen and driver logic use three point three volts. Exact GPIO connections, named component pins, LED resistor and motor winding pairs are shown.
svg.text: ESP32-C3 Super Mini • named pins, not physical header positions • 24 V is an example
ADD THIS • rated for 24 V input
Size for both servo peak currents
COMMON 0 V / GND — supply negatives, USB ground and every component ground
USB powers the C3 only. The external DC/DC powers both servos. Do not join the two +5 V outputs.
Dots = connected wires. Crossings without dots = separate wires. Confirm ratings and calibrate motor travel first.
